blocks.zh: Learning Objectives / 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Understand the USP three-stage conductivity testing methodology and temperature-dependent limits / 理解 USP 三階段電導率測試方法及溫度依賴性限值
blocks.en: Understand the USP three-stage conductivity testing methodology and temperature-dependent limits

blocks.zh: Describe TOC measurement principles, oxidation methods, and CO<sub>2</sub> detection techniques / 描述 TOC 量測原理、氧化方法及 CO<sub>2</sub> 偵測技術
blocks.en: Describe TOC measurement principles, oxidation methods (conversion to CO<sub>2</sub>), and CO<sub>2</sub> detection techniques

blocks.zh: Explain the differences between EP and USP water quality requirements / 說明 EP 與 USP 水質要求之差異
blocks.en: Explain the differences between EP and USP water quality requirements

blocks.zh: Describe the passivation process, chemical alternatives, and application methods / 描述鈍化製程、化學替代品及應用方法
blocks.en: Describe the passivation process, chemical alternatives, and application methods

blocks.zh: Identify tests for cleanliness and passivity verification / 辨識清潔度與鈍化驗證的檢測方法
blocks.en: Identify tests for cleanliness and passivity verification

blocks.zh: Understand the rouging phenomenon, its causes, and remediation strategies / 理解紅銹現象、成因及修復策略
blocks.en: Understand the rouging phenomenon, its causes, and remediation strategies

blocks.zh: Outline documentation requirements for passivation activities / 概述鈍化活動的文件記錄要求
blocks.en: Outline documentation requirements for passivation activities

blocks.zh: 11.1 USP Regulated Water Quality / USP 法規水質
blocks.en: 11.1 USP Regulated Water Quality

blocks.zh: Commentary / 教學解說
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 三階段電導率測試架構
blocks.en: Three-Stage Conductivity Testing Framework

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為什麼要三階段？
blocks.en: Core concept: why three stages?

blocks.zh: USP 設計三階段測試是為了在效率與準確性之間取得平衡：
blocks.en: USP designed the three-stage test to balance efficiency and accuracy:

blocks.zh: Stage 1（線上）：快速篩檢，90%以上的樣品在此階段通過
blocks.en: Stage 1 (in-line): a quick screen; more than 90% of samples pass at this stage

blocks.zh: Stage 2（離線）：溫度標準化到 25°C，排除溫度影響
blocks.en: Stage 2 (off-line): the sample is normalized to 25°C to remove the effect of temperature

blocks.zh: Stage 3（實驗室）：加入 pH 測量，考慮鹼度對電導率的影響
blocks.en: Stage 3 (laboratory): adds a pH measurement to account for the effect of alkalinity on conductivity

blocks.zh: 生活比喻
blocks.en: Real-life analogy

blocks.zh: 就像機場安檢的三道關卡：第一道是金屬探測門（快速通過），第二道是手持掃描器（進一步確認），第三道是開箱檢查（完整檢驗）。大多數旅客在第一道就通過了。
blocks.en: Think of three airport security checkpoints: the first is the metal detector (quick pass-through), the second is the handheld scanner (further confirmation), and the third is the bag check (full inspection). Most travelers clear the first checkpoint.

blocks.zh: 實務重點
blocks.en: Practical points

blocks.zh: Stage 1 使用非溫度補償的感測器 — 這是刻意設計，因為限值已經按溫度區間設定
blocks.en: Stage 1 uses a non-temperature-compensated sensor. This is deliberate, because the limits are already set by temperature band

blocks.zh: Stage 2 失敗才需要做 Stage 3 — 不是每個樣品都需要做到底
blocks.en: Stage 3 is needed only if Stage 2 fails; not every sample has to go through all three stages

blocks.zh: Stage 3 的 pH 測量必須在電導率讀數後 5 分鐘內完成，避免 CO<sub>2</sub> 吸收影響
blocks.en: The pH measurement in Stage 3 must be completed within 5 minutes of the conductivity reading to avoid CO<sub>2</sub> absorption affecting the result

blocks.zh: 電導率限值表解讀
blocks.en: Interpreting the Conductivity Limits Table

blocks.zh: 溫度與電導率的關係
blocks.en: Relationship between temperature and conductivity

blocks.zh: 水溫越高，離子活動度越大，電導率自然越高。USP 的限值隨溫度上升而放寬：
blocks.en: The higher the water temperature, the greater the ion mobility and the higher the conductivity. The USP limits relax as temperature rises:

blocks.zh: 0°C 時限值僅 0.6 µS/cm
blocks.en: At 0°C the limit is only 0.6 µS/cm

blocks.zh: 25°C 時限值為 1.3 µS/cm（標準參考點）
blocks.en: At 25°C the limit is 1.3 µS/cm (the standard reference point)

blocks.zh: 100°C 時限值放寬到 3.1 µS/cm
blocks.en: At 100°C the limit relaxes to 3.1 µS/cm

blocks.zh: 常見陷阱
blocks.en: Common pitfalls

blocks.zh: 熱水循環系統（80°C）的線上電導率 2.5 µS/cm 是合格的 — 不要用 25°C 的標準來判斷
blocks.en: An in-line conductivity of 2.5 µS/cm in a hot water loop (80°C) is acceptable. Do not judge it against the 25°C limit

blocks.zh: 75-94.9°C 合併為一個區間（2.7 µS/cm），這是因為在此高溫範圍內變化較小
blocks.en: The 75-94.9°C range is combined into one band (2.7 µS/cm), because the limit changes little in this high-temperature range

blocks.zh: 實際操作中，良好系統的電導率通常遠低於限值
blocks.en: In practice, a well-run system usually reads far below the limit

blocks.zh: Stage 2 & 3 補充
blocks.en: Stage 2 & 3 supplement

blocks.zh: Stage 2：將樣品調到 25°C 測量，限值為 2.1 µS/cm。
blocks.en: Stage 2: the sample is adjusted to 25°C and measured; the limit is 2.1 µS/cm.

blocks.zh: Stage 3：在 25°C 下測量 pH，再對照 pH-電導率對照表判定。此階段考慮了大氣 CO2 溶入的影響。
blocks.en: Stage 3: pH is measured at 25°C and the result is checked against the pH-conductivity table. This stage accounts for the effect of dissolved atmospheric CO2.

blocks.zh: 11.1.5-11.1.6 Total Organic Carbon (TOC) / 總有機碳
blocks.en: 11.1.5-11.1.6 Total Organic Carbon (TOC)

blocks.zh: TOC 測量基礎
blocks.en: TOC Measurement Basics

blocks.zh: 什麼是 TOC？
blocks.en: What is TOC?

blocks.zh: Total Organic Carbon（總有機碳）是水中有機物含量的間接指標。USP 限值為 500 ppb。
blocks.en: Total Organic Carbon is an indirect indicator of the organic content of water. The USP limit is 500 ppb.

blocks.zh: 基本原理：將水中有機物完全氧化為 CO<sub>2</sub>，再量測 CO<sub>2</sub> 的濃度換算回碳含量。
blocks.en: Basic principle: the organic matter in the water is fully oxidized to CO<sub>2</sub>, and the CO<sub>2</sub> concentration is measured and converted back to carbon content.

blocks.zh: TC = TOC + IC（Total Carbon = 有機碳 + 無機碳）
blocks.en: TC = TOC + IC (Total Carbon = organic carbon + inorganic carbon)

blocks.zh: TOC 測量就像燃燒垃圾來秤重：你把所有有機物燒成 CO<sub>2</sub>，量測 CO<sub>2</sub> 的量，就知道原本有多少有機物。但要先扣除水中原本就有的 CO<sub>2</sub>（無機碳），才能得到真正的有機碳含量。
blocks.en: TOC measurement is like burning rubbish to weigh it: you burn all the organic matter to CO<sub>2</sub> and measure how much CO<sub>2</sub> there is, which tells you how much organic matter you started with. But you must first subtract the CO<sub>2</sub> that was already in the water (inorganic carbon) to get the true organic carbon content.

blocks.zh: 偵測極限的重要性
blocks.en: Why the detection limit matters

blocks.zh: USP 要求儀器的偵測極限 ≤0.05 mg/L（50 ppb），這是限值 500 ppb 的 1/10。在製藥用水中，IC 通常很低，不需要特別去除。
blocks.en: USP requires an instrument detection limit of ≤0.05 mg/L (50 ppb), which is 1/10 of the 500 ppb limit. In pharmaceutical water, IC is usually very low and does not need to be specifically removed.

blocks.zh: TOC 分析儀技術比較
blocks.en: Comparison of TOC Analyzer Technologies

blocks.zh: 四種氧化方法
blocks.en: Four oxidation methods

blocks.zh: 高溫燃燒（>500°C）：最暴力、最徹底，適合未知樣品，但需要壓縮氧氣
blocks.en: High-temperature combustion (>500°C): the most aggressive and thorough method, suited to unknown samples, but it requires compressed oxygen

blocks.zh: 熱活化過硫酸鹽：用熱能產生強氧化性自由基，可處理大分子
blocks.en: Heated persulfate: thermal energy generates strongly oxidizing radicals and can handle large molecules

blocks.zh: UV 活化過硫酸鹽：用紫外線激活，可量測 50-100 ppm 的高濃度 TOC
blocks.en: UV-promoted persulfate: activated by ultraviolet light; can measure high TOC concentrations of 50-100 ppm

blocks.zh: 純 UV 光（<195 nm）：不需外加化學品！最適合線上監測，但上限較低（~250 ppb 無氧，~2000 ppb 含氧）
blocks.en: UV light alone (<195 nm): no added chemicals needed! Best suited to on-line monitoring, but with a lower upper limit (~250 ppb without oxygen, ~2000 ppb with oxygen)

blocks.zh: 選擇指南
blocks.en: Selection guide

blocks.zh: 線上持續監測：純 UV 光法最簡便（不需化學品），適合製藥用水
blocks.en: Continuous on-line monitoring: UV light alone is the simplest (no chemicals needed) and suits pharmaceutical water

blocks.zh: 實驗室分析：高溫燃燒或過硫酸鹽法，量測範圍更廣
blocks.en: Laboratory analysis: high-temperature combustion or persulfate methods, which have a wider measuring range

blocks.zh: 過硫酸鹽法對 >30 µm 的大顆粒氧化困難
blocks.en: Persulfate methods have difficulty oxidizing large particles (>30 µm)

blocks.zh: CO<sub>2</sub> 偵測方法比較
blocks.en: Comparison of CO<sub>2</sub> Detection Methods

blocks.zh: 限度回應與系統適用性測試
blocks.en: Limit Response and System Suitability Testing

blocks.zh: 兩個關鍵公式
blocks.en: Two key formulas

blocks.zh: 限度回應測試（Limit Response）：
blocks.en: Limit Response test:

blocks.zh:
r_t < (r_S - r_W)
測試樣品回應 < (蔗糖標準液回應 - 試劑水回應)
blocks.en:
r_t < (r_S - r_W)
Test sample response < (sucrose standard response - reagent water response)

blocks.zh: 適用性測試（Suitability）：
blocks.en: Suitability test:

100 x [(r_SS - r_W) / (r_S - r_W)] = 100% +/- 15%
The benzoquinone response efficiency must be between 85% and 115%

blocks.zh: 為什麼用蔗糖和苯醌？
blocks.en: Why sucrose and benzoquinone?

blocks.zh: 蔗糖（sucrose）：非常容易被氧化，作為「最佳情況」的標準品。
blocks.en: Sucrose: very easy to oxidize; serves as the "best case" standard.

blocks.zh: 1,4-苯醌（benzoquinone）：較難被氧化，用來測試儀器能否處理「困難」的有機物。如果儀器對苯醌的回應效率在 ±15% 以內，表示它能有效氧化各類有機物。
blocks.en: 1,4-Benzoquinone: harder to oxidize; used to test whether the instrument can handle "difficult" organic compounds. If the instrument's response efficiency for benzoquinone is within ±15%, it can oxidize organics of all kinds effectively.

blocks.zh: 線上 vs 離線測試頻率
blocks.en: On-line vs. off-line testing frequency

blocks.zh: 線上儀器做標準化測試需要斷開水系統，成本高
blocks.en: Standardizing an on-line instrument requires disconnecting it from the water system, which is costly

blocks.zh: 每日一次標準化可接受；適用性測試可每月一次
blocks.en: Standardization once a day is acceptable; the suitability test can be performed monthly

blocks.zh: 有些 TOC 儀器內建自動化測試功能，可節省大量時間和費用
blocks.en: Some TOC instruments have built-in automated testing functions, which can save a great deal of time and cost

blocks.zh: 微生物、內毒素與 pH 測試
blocks.en: Microbial, Endotoxin, and pH Testing

blocks.zh: 微生物與內毒素取樣
blocks.en: Microbial and endotoxin sampling

blocks.zh: 必須在使用點（POU）取樣，因為微生物可能在管路末端繁殖。不能只在產水點取樣就代表整個系統合格。
blocks.en: Samples must be taken at the point of use (POU), because microorganisms can proliferate at the end of the piping. A sample taken only at the point of generation cannot represent the whole system.

blocks.zh: pH 測試的演變
blocks.en: Evolution of pH testing

blocks.zh: 1998 年 5 月起，USP 取消了用 pH 測試來輔助線上電導率測試的要求。原因：
blocks.en: Since May 1998, USP has dropped the requirement for pH testing to support in-line conductivity testing. The reasons:

blocks.zh: 高純水的 pH 極難準確測量
blocks.en: The pH of high-purity water is extremely difficult to measure accurately

blocks.zh: 三階段電導率測試已涵蓋 pH 的影響
blocks.en: The three-stage conductivity test already covers the effect of pH

blocks.zh: EP 仍保留獨立的 pH 測試要求
blocks.en: EP still retains a separate pH test requirement

blocks.zh: 雙用途 TOC/電導率儀器
blocks.en: Dual-purpose TOC/conductivity instruments

blocks.zh: 越來越多線上 TOC 儀器兼具電導率測量功能。要符合 USP 要求，電導率池必須獨立校正，使用 NIST 可追溯的精密電阻器（精度 ±0.1%）。
blocks.en: More and more on-line TOC instruments also measure conductivity. To meet USP requirements, the conductivity cell must be calibrated independently, using NIST-traceable precision resistors (accuracy ±0.1%).

blocks.zh: 11.2 European Perspective / 歐洲觀點
blocks.en: 11.2 European Perspective

blocks.zh: 歐洲法規架構
blocks.en: European Regulatory Framework

blocks.zh: 歐洲藥品監管體系
blocks.en: European medicines regulatory system

blocks.zh: 歐洲的架構是中央（EMEA）+ 國家機構雙層制：
blocks.en: Europe has a two-tier structure of central (EMEA) + national authorities:

blocks.zh: EMEA 負責跨歐洲的集中審批（生技產品強制）
blocks.en: EMEA handles centralized approval across Europe (mandatory for biotech products)

blocks.zh: 各國機構負責國內註冊和工廠檢查
blocks.en: National authorities handle domestic registration and site inspections

blocks.zh: PIC/S 提供非約束性的檢查指南，促進協調
blocks.en: PIC/S provides non-binding inspection guidance and promotes harmonization

blocks.zh: 水和蒸汽的法規來源
blocks.en: Regulatory sources for water and steam

blocks.zh: 水質標準：EP（歐洲藥典）
blocks.en: Water quality standards: EP (European Pharmacopoeia)

blocks.zh: 潔淨蒸汽品質：EN 285 + HTM-2010/2031
blocks.en: Clean steam quality: EN 285 + HTM-2010/2031

blocks.zh: EP 不規範潔淨蒸汽 — 這是歐洲與美國的重要差異
blocks.en: EP does not specify clean steam, which is an important difference between Europe and the US

blocks.zh: EU cGMP 附錄僅要求蒸汽品質「適當」且不含汙染物
blocks.en: The EU cGMP annex only requires that steam quality be "appropriate" and free of contaminants

blocks.zh: EP vs USP 關鍵差異
blocks.en: Key Differences: EP vs. USP

blocks.zh: 蒸汽品質三大關注點
blocks.en: Three key concerns for steam quality

blocks.zh: 乾燥度（Dryness）：≥0.9（金屬負載 ≥0.95）。過濕會造成多孔負載潮濕；「過乾」可能過熱
blocks.en: Dryness: ≥0.9 (≥0.95 for metal loads). Steam that is too wet leaves porous loads damp; steam that is "too dry" may be superheated

blocks.zh: 過熱度（Superheat）：過熱蒸汽殺菌效果差。控制夾套溫度和閥門壓降可預防
blocks.en: Superheat: superheated steam has poor sterilizing effect. It can be prevented by controlling jacket temperature and pressure drop across valves

blocks.zh: 不凝結氣體（NCGs）：空氣和 CO2 會形成「氣穴」，阻止蒸汽穿透。預處理進水加熱至 80°C 以上脫氣
blocks.en: Non-condensable gases (NCGs): air and CO2 form "air pockets" that prevent steam penetration. Degas the feed water by pre-heating it above 80°C

blocks.zh: 實務影響
blocks.en: Practical implications

blocks.zh: 如果你的產品同時銷售歐美市場，水系統設計必須同時滿足 USP 和 EP 要求。最安全的做法是採用最嚴格的標準組合：USP 的電導率/TOC 測試 + EP 的蒸餾法 WFI + EP 的取樣量。
blocks.en: If your product is sold in both the US and European markets, the water system design must meet both USP and EP requirements. The safest approach is to adopt the most stringent combination of standards: USP conductivity/TOC testing + EP distillation-based WFI + EP sample volumes.

blocks.zh: 11.3 Passivation / 鈍化
blocks.en: 11.3 Passivation

blocks.zh: 鈍化基礎原理
blocks.en: Fundamentals of Passivation

blocks.zh: 什麼是鈍化？
blocks.en: What is passivation?

blocks.zh: 鈍化是在不鏽鋼表面形成一層氧化鉻保護膜的過程。這層膜：
blocks.en: Passivation is the process of forming a protective chromium oxide film on the stainless steel surface. This film:

blocks.zh: 厚度僅 0.5-5.0 nm（奈米級，肉眼不可見）
blocks.en: Is only 0.5-5.0 nm thick (nanometer scale, invisible to the naked eye)

blocks.zh: 平均 2-3 nm
blocks.en: Averages 2-3 nm

blocks.zh: 使金屬表面「鈍性」— 不再與環境發生化學反應
blocks.en: Makes the metal surface "passive", so it no longer reacts chemically with the environment

blocks.zh: 鈍化就像給不鏽鋼「打蠟」。新車出廠時有保護漆，但如果刮傷了（像焊接破壞表面），就需要重新上漆（鈍化）。這層「蠟」是氧化鉻，只有幾奈米厚，但能有效阻擋腐蝕。
blocks.en: Passivation is like "waxing" stainless steel. A new car leaves the factory with protective paint, but if it gets scratched (as welding damages the surface), it has to be repainted (passivated). This "wax" is chromium oxide; it is only a few nanometers thick, yet it blocks corrosion effectively.

blocks.zh: 關鍵數據
blocks.en: Key data

blocks.zh: 鉻鐵比（Cr/Fe ratio）：至少 1:1，最佳 ≥2:1
blocks.en: Chromium-to-iron ratio (Cr/Fe ratio): at least 1:1, optimally ≥2:1

blocks.zh: 鉻含量 ≥17% 的 300 系列不鏽鋼都需要鈍化
blocks.en: 300-series stainless steels with chromium content ≥17% all require passivation

blocks.zh: 任何經過焊接、加工、搬運的表面都應鈍化
blocks.en: Any surface that has been welded, machined, or handled should be passivated

blocks.zh: 焊接會破壞現有的被動膜，特別是熱影響區
blocks.en: Welding destroys the existing passive film, especially in the heat-affected zone

blocks.zh: 鈍化程序四步驟
blocks.en: The Four-Step Passivation Procedure

blocks.zh: 四步驟流程
blocks.en: Four-step process

blocks.zh:
Step 1: 脫脂清洗
↓
Step 2: 水沖洗
↓
Step 3: 酸洗（鈍化）
↓
Step 4: 最終水沖洗
blocks.en:
Step 1: Degrease
↓
Step 2: Water rinse
↓
Step 3: Acid wash (passivation)
↓
Step 4: Final water rinse

blocks.zh: 驗證重點
blocks.en: Verification points

blocks.zh: 使用系統的焊接試片來測試程序效果 — 不要只靠理論
blocks.en: Use the system's own weld coupons to test the effectiveness of the procedure; do not rely on theory alone

blocks.zh: 最終沖洗的判定標準：出水品質 = 進水品質
blocks.en: Acceptance criterion for the final rinse: outlet water quality = inlet water quality

blocks.zh: 所有程序開發資料應納入驗證文件包
blocks.en: All procedure development data should be included in the validation documentation package

blocks.zh: 參考 ASTM A 380-96 是產業標準做法
blocks.en: Referencing ASTM A 380-96 is standard industry practice

blocks.zh: 鈍化化學品選擇
blocks.en: Choice of Passivation Chemicals

blocks.zh: 產業趨勢
blocks.en: Industry trend

blocks.zh: 從硝酸轉向檸檬酸 + 螯合劑的組合：
blocks.en: The move from nitric acid to citric acid + chelant combinations:

blocks.zh: 安全性：檸檬酸對人員和環境更安全
blocks.en: Safety: citric acid is safer for personnel and the environment

blocks.zh: 成本：廢液處理更簡單便宜
blocks.en: Cost: waste treatment is simpler and cheaper

blocks.zh: 有效性：配合 EDTA 等螯合劑可達到類似效果
blocks.en: Effectiveness: combined with chelants such as EDTA, similar results can be achieved

blocks.zh: 電拋光管材 + 軌道焊接 = 可使用更溫和的鈍化條件
blocks.en: Electropolished tubing + orbital welding = milder passivation conditions can be used

blocks.zh: ASTM 的區分
blocks.en: The ASTM distinction

blocks.zh: ASTM A 380 將檸檬酸歸類為清洗酸（cleaning acid）而非鈍化酸（passivating acid），因為檸檬酸本身不是氧化劑。要實現真正的氧化鈍化，需要額外加入螯合劑或氧化劑。
blocks.en: ASTM A 380 classifies citric acid as a cleaning acid rather than a passivating acid, because citric acid is not itself an oxidizer. To achieve true oxidative passivation, a chelant or oxidizer must be added.

blocks.zh: 應用方法與測試
blocks.en: Application Methods and Testing

blocks.zh: 應用方法選擇指南
blocks.en: Guide to choosing an application method

blocks.zh: 循環法（首選）：適合管路系統，流速 ≥1.5 m/s
blocks.en: Circulation (preferred): suited to piping systems, flow velocity ≥1.5 m/s

blocks.zh: 注意：高流速不等於顆粒去除！1000 英尺的管路需要約 25 小時的過濾循環才能完全去除顆粒
blocks.en: Note: high flow velocity does not equal particle removal! A 1000-foot pipe run needs about 25 hours of filtered circulation to remove particles completely

blocks.zh: 噴塗法：適合槽體內部
blocks.en: Spraying: suited to the inside of tanks

blocks.zh: 浸泡法：適合小零件和預製管件
blocks.en: Immersion: suited to small parts and prefabricated fittings

blocks.zh: 擦拭法：最後手段，用於無法噴塗或循環的區域
blocks.en: Wiping: a last resort, for areas that cannot be sprayed or circulated

blocks.zh: 實務建議
blocks.en: Practical recommendations

blocks.zh: Ferroxyl 測試最常用：便宜、快速（15 秒出結果）
blocks.en: The Ferroxyl test is the most commonly used: inexpensive and fast (result in 15 seconds)

blocks.zh: XPS/AES 較昂貴，最適合用於焊接試片以驗證程序有效性
blocks.en: XPS/AES are more expensive and best used on weld coupons to verify the effectiveness of the procedure

blocks.zh: 假設邏輯：無游離鐵 → 表面夠乾淨 → 氧化膜可均勻形成
blocks.en: Underlying logic: no free iron → surface clean enough → oxide film can form uniformly

blocks.zh: 紅銹（Rouging）現象
blocks.en: The Rouging Phenomenon

blocks.zh: 什麼是紅銹？
blocks.en: What is rouge?

blocks.zh: 紅銹是在不鏽鋼水系統中自然形成的氧化鐵薄膜。主要成分是 Fe2O3（三氧化二鐵），也含鉻和鎳。
blocks.en: Rouge is a thin iron oxide film that forms naturally in stainless steel water systems. Its main component is Fe2O3 (ferric oxide), and it also contains chromium and nickel.

blocks.zh: 常見於：
blocks.en: Commonly found in:

blocks.zh: 80°C 高溫純水系統
blocks.en: 80°C hot purified water systems

blocks.zh: 潔淨蒸汽系統
blocks.en: Clean steam systems

blocks.zh: 蒸餾設備
blocks.en: Distillation equipment

blocks.zh: 顏色代表什麼？
blocks.en: What do the colors mean?

blocks.zh: 紅色系（橙、紅、紅棕）：高溫純水系統最常見
blocks.en: Red tones (orange, red, reddish brown): most common in hot purified water systems

blocks.zh: 藍黑色系（紫、藍、灰、黑）：潔淨蒸汽系統常見
blocks.en: Blue-black tones (purple, blue, gray, black): common in clean steam systems

blocks.zh: 可以是鬆散灰塵狀（容易擦掉）到頑固薄膜（需要刮除）
blocks.en: It can range from a loose, dusty deposit (easily wiped off) to a stubborn film (requiring scraping)

blocks.zh: 紅銹有時是多層的，不同層有不同顏色和質地
blocks.en: Rouge is sometimes multi-layered, with different colors and textures in different layers

blocks.zh: FDA 的立場
blocks.en: FDA's position

blocks.zh: FDA 沒有針對紅銹發布任何書面立場。唯一的標準是水質是否符合 USP 要求。紅銹本身未被證明會影響水質。
blocks.en: FDA has not issued any written position on rouging. The only standard is whether the water meets USP requirements. Rouge itself has not been shown to affect water quality.

blocks.zh: 但業界的擔憂是：隨時間推移，薄膜可能脫落並分散到系統中 — 這在過濾使用點的濾器變色中可以觀察到。
blocks.en: The industry's concern, however, is that over time the film may flake off and disperse into the system, as can be observed in the discoloration of point-of-use filters.

blocks.zh: 去銹（Derouging）策略
blocks.en: Derouging Strategy

blocks.zh: 案例：某冷 WFI 系統去銹鈍化三次，每次一週內又完全紅銹。原因始終未確定 — 紅銹具有高度場址特異性。
blocks.en: Case: a cold WFI system was derouged and passivated three times, and each time it was fully rouged again within a week. The cause was never determined; rouging is highly site-specific.

blocks.zh: 系統準備、化學配方與文件
blocks.en: System Preparation, Chemical Formulations, and Documentation

blocks.zh: 鈍化前準備清單
blocks.en: Pre-passivation preparation checklist

blocks.zh: 完成水壓測試 — 確保系統無洩漏
blocks.en: Complete the hydrostatic test to confirm the system has no leaks

blocks.zh: 確認所有組件與鈍化液相容性 — 不相容的移除
blocks.en: Confirm that all components are compatible with the passivation solution; remove those that are not

blocks.zh: 將系統與其他系統隔離
blocks.en: Isolate the system from other systems

blocks.zh: 消除所有死角（dead legs）
blocks.en: Eliminate all dead legs

blocks.zh: 確保高點排氣和低點排水
blocks.en: Ensure venting at high points and draining at low points

blocks.zh: 檢查自動控制 — 避免異常溫度觸發轉向閥
blocks.en: Check the automatic controls, so that abnormal temperatures do not trigger diverter valves

blocks.zh: 六種化學配方速查
blocks.en: Quick reference: six chemical formulations

blocks.zh: C1 硝酸：標準鈍化，室溫 30-60 分鐘
blocks.en: C1 Nitric acid: standard passivation, 30-60 minutes at room temperature

blocks.zh: C2 鹼性脫脂：去除有機膜和顆粒
blocks.en: C2 Alkaline degreaser: removes organic films and particles

blocks.zh: C3 檸檬酸/螯合劑：可去除鐵、錳、鋁、銅等金屬
blocks.en: C3 Citric acid/chelant: removes metals such as iron, manganese, aluminum, and copper

blocks.zh: C4 礦酸：磷酸/硫酸/氨基磺酸，3-10%
blocks.en: C4 Mineral acids: phosphoric/sulfuric/sulfamic acid, 3-10%

blocks.zh: C5 強化酸/螯合劑：對付高溫氧化膜和矽垢
blocks.en: C5 Enhanced acid/chelant: for high-temperature oxide films and silica scale

blocks.zh: C6 連二亞硫酸鈉：強還原劑，用於去銹
blocks.en: C6 Sodium hydrosulfite: a strong reducing agent, used for derouging

blocks.zh: 廢液處理三選項
blocks.en: Three options for spent solution disposal

blocks.zh: 排入化學排水系統（需有相容處理設施）
blocks.en: Discharge to a chemical drain system (requires a compatible treatment facility)

blocks.zh: 在承包商設備中中和後排放
blocks.en: Neutralize in the contractor's equipment, then discharge

blocks.zh: 場外處置（最貴，需驗證運輸商和處理廠資質）
blocks.en: Off-site disposal (the most expensive; the qualifications of the transporter and treatment facility must be verified)

blocks.zh: 關鍵：廢液中的鉻和鎳是優先污染物金屬，不可直接排入雨水排水系統。
blocks.en: Critical: chromium and nickel in the spent solution are priority pollutant metals and must not be discharged directly to the storm drain system.

blocks.zh: 文件記錄要求
blocks.en: Documentation Requirements

blocks.zh: 鈍化文件應納入最終驗證文件包，包含：
blocks.en: Passivation documentation should be included in the final validation documentation package, and should contain:

blocks.zh: 鈍化程序書
blocks.en: Passivation procedure

blocks.zh: 程序開發資料（試片測試結果）
blocks.en: Procedure development data (coupon test results)

blocks.zh: 測試程序與設備
blocks.en: Test procedures and equipment

blocks.zh: 校正文件
blocks.en: Calibration documentation

blocks.zh: 鈍化日誌表
blocks.en: Passivation log sheets

blocks.zh: 化學品批次記錄
blocks.en: Chemical batch records

blocks.zh: 標記的系統圖紙（point check list）
blocks.en: Marked-up system drawings (point check list)

blocks.zh: Practice Questions / 練習思考
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: Your hot WFI system at 80°C shows an in-line conductivity of 2.6 µS/cm. Does it pass Stage 1? What is the limit at this temperature? / 你的熱 WFI 系統在 80°C 下線上電導率為 2.6 µS/cm，是否通過 Stage 1？此溫度的限值是多少？
blocks.en: Your hot WFI system at 80°C shows an in-line conductivity of 2.6 µS/cm. Does it pass Stage 1? What is the limit at this temperature?

blocks.zh: An auditor asks why you are not performing pH testing on your PW system. How do you respond? / 稽核員問你為什麼 PW 系統不做 pH 測試，你如何回答？
blocks.en: An auditor asks why you are not performing pH testing on your PW system. How do you respond?

blocks.zh: Your system serves both US and EU markets. Which WFI production method must you use? / 你的系統同時供應美國和歐洲市場，WFI 必須用什麼方法生產？
blocks.en: Your system serves both US and EU markets. Which WFI production method must you use?

blocks.zh: After passivation, the Ferroxyl test shows a blue stain at one weld location. What is your next step? / 鈍化後，Ferroxyl 測試在一個焊接處出現藍色斑點，下一步該怎麼做？
blocks.en: After passivation, the Ferroxyl test shows a blue stain at one weld location. What is your next step?

blocks.zh: Your facility discovers rouging in a 6-month-old hot WFI system. The water still meets USP specs. What do you recommend? / 你的設施在一個使用 6 個月的熱 WFI 系統中發現紅銹，水質仍符合 USP 標準。你的建議是什麼？
blocks.en: Your facility discovers rouging in a 6-month-old hot WFI system. The water still meets USP specs. What do you recommend?

blocks.zh: Section Summary / 本節摘要
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: USP Three-Stage Conductivity: A tiered testing approach (in-line → off-line → lab) with temperature-dependent limits from 0.6 to 3.1 µS/cm / USP 三階段電導率：分層測試架構，溫度依賴限值 0.6-3.1 µS/cm
blocks.en: USP Three-Stage Conductivity: A tiered testing approach (in-line → off-line → lab) with temperature-dependent limits from 0.6 to 3.1 µS/cm

blocks.zh: TOC Testing: Limit 500 ppb; four oxidation methods and four CO2 detection methods; suitability testing with sucrose and benzoquinone / TOC 測試：限值 500 ppb；四種氧化法與四種 CO2 偵測法
blocks.en: TOC Testing: Limit 500 ppb; four oxidation methods (conversion to CO2) and four CO2 detection methods; suitability testing with sucrose and benzoquinone

blocks.zh: EP vs USP Differences: EP requires distillation-only WFI, retains pH testing, has not adopted conductivity or TOC testing / EP 與 USP 差異：EP 要求蒸餾法 WFI，保留 pH 測試，未採用電導率或 TOC 測試
blocks.en: EP vs USP Differences: EP requires distillation-only WFI, retains pH testing, has not adopted conductivity or TOC testing

blocks.zh: Passivation: Four-step process (degrease, rinse, acid wash, rinse) to form protective chromium oxide film (0.5-5 nm); Cr/Fe ratio ≥1:1 / 鈍化四步驟建立氧化鉻保護膜
blocks.en: Passivation: Four-step process (degrease, rinse, acid wash, rinse) to form protective chromium oxide film (0.5-5 nm); Cr/Fe ratio ≥1:1

blocks.zh: Chemical Alternatives: Industry trending from nitric acid to citric acid + chelants for safety and environmental reasons / 化學品趨勢從硝酸轉向檸檬酸 + 螯合劑
blocks.en: Chemical Alternatives: Industry trending from nitric acid to citric acid + chelants for safety and environmental reasons

blocks.zh: Rouging: Common but unregulated phenomenon; ferric oxide film in hot water/steam systems; site-specific; does not necessarily affect water quality / 紅銹：常見但無法規要求，場址特異性高，不一定影響水質
blocks.en: Rouging: Common but unregulated phenomenon; ferric oxide film in hot water/steam systems; site-specific; does not necessarily affect water quality

blocks.zh: Documentation: Comprehensive records (procedures, logs, batch records, system drawings) required for validation / 文件記錄：完整的鈍化記錄需納入驗證文件
blocks.en: Documentation: Comprehensive records (procedures, logs, batch records, system drawings) required for validation
